value.criterion: AC1, AC2: claims are next-in-line and never collide
value.proof: BUILD: pij-store tests for the next number from claims and from a scratch checkout's files; ten concurrent claims distinct and consecutive; two projects independent. `cargo test -p pij-store claims`.

value.criterion: AC3: release on tombstone, on merge and by hand
value.proof: BUILD: tombstoning the claiming seat releases its open claims in the same transaction; a released number is never reissued; `pij claims` lists both states.

value.criterion: AC4, AC5: delivered records once and prints edits
value.proof: BUILD: pij-daemon tests with a fake gh: merged PR with a Delivers line records rows and prints ddocs set commands; re-run is idempotent; an unmerged PR and a missing line refuse by name; no file in the project changes (git status clean).
BUILD: a private daemon shows the delivery on the PM seat's card after one call (via --pm, and via the pm-<n> holder if plan 195 is merged).
value.receipt: claims_http card asserts; private-run.txt PM card

value.criterion: AC7, AC9: convention, docs and states
value.proof: EXTEND: skill verb coverage tests; `just ddocs-check`; `ddocs validate` on the project docs; CI on the exact head; reviewer and security verdicts.
value.receipt: skill_verb_coverage 4/4; ddocs-check 7 clean; TS and verdicts on the PR head

value.proof: EXTEND: spawn_sites.rs covers the gh launch site. Private daemon: spawn counter delta around one claim (0), one claims list (0) and one delivered (1), with data.pid. Live fleet before and after deploy: `pij-rs --json ping | jq .data.spawns` twice 60 s apart and `just spawn-rate --seconds 20`; expected no change at rest.
